subject: POC Kickoff: Align on success criteria, timeline, and owners
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>, Bob Liu <bob.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC Kickoff: Align on success criteria, timeline, and owners

Hi Alice / Bob,

Thanks again for agreeing to run the POC with Redwood. To make the kickoff useful for everyone, I put together a short success-criteria doc (attached) and a couple of candidate kickoff slots below. Can you confirm the attendees from your side (engineering + security + procurement), and which slot you prefer?

Candidate kickoff slots (PT):
- Tue Oct 6, 10:00–11:00
- Thu Oct 8, 13:00–14:00
- Fri Oct 9, 15:00–16:00

Note: Ethan (SE) and Dev (Security/Integrations) are copied — we’ll need a short tech pre-call if Acme wants to review firewall/network requirements ahead of the kickoff. I attached the current success criteria and a draft calendar invite (poc-calendar.ics).

High-level owners for the kickoff:
- Redwood AE: Marissa Cole (owner, logistics / agenda)
- Redwood SE: Ethan Park (tech lead for demo + onboarding)
- Redwood Security/Integrations: Dev Patel (data/security checklist)
- Acme: Alice Chen (product), Bob Liu (infra).

Please confirm attendees and pick a slot by EOD Monday 10/5 so we can lock calendars.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: acme_poc_success_criteria_v1.docx, poc-calendar.ics

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Liu <bob.liu@acme.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: Align on success criteria, timeline, and owners

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — appreciative of the clear agenda. A couple of constraints on our side: procurement is heads-down the week of 10/4 (we have a budgeting freeze) so they asked not to be scheduled for decision/PO discussions that week. Also, our Security team needs to run through your questionnaire with one of our engineers; they prefer the pre-call be at least 24 hours before the kickoff.

Preferable kickoff windows for our team (PT):
- Mon Oct 12, 10:00–11:00
- Tue Oct 13, 14:00–15:00

If those don’t work for Redwood, we can flex earlier week if procurement confirms availability — but 10/12 or 10/13 are ideal.

For attendees: please include our infra engineer Sam Park (sam.park@acme.com) and security lead Mei Zhang (mei.zhang@acme.com). I’m looping procurement to keep them in the thread.

Best,
Alice
Alice Chen | Sr. Product Manager, Acme Corp
alice.chen@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>, Bob Liu <bob.liu@acme.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@acme.com>, Mei Zhang <mei.zhang@acme.com>
Cc: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@acme.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 08:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: Align on success criteria, timeline, and owners

Hi Alice — thanks for the context and for adding Sam/Mei.

We can absolutely accommodate 10/12 or 10/13 if that’s ideal for Acme. Two quick asks before we finalize:
1) Ethan / Dev — can you confirm availability for the proposed Acme-preferred windows?
2) Alice — can you confirm that procurement only needs to be present for the final commercial discussion (not the kickoff demo)?

To try to keep momentum I’ll propose two firm options and we can pick:
- Option A: Fri Oct 10, 14:00–15:00 PT (Redwood prefers this to keep the week moving)
- Option B: Tue Oct 13, 14:00–15:00 PT (Acme-preferred)

If we pick Option A, we’ll plan a short 30–45m tech pre-call the day prior (Thu Oct 9) for Mei + Sam + Ethan + Dev to cover network/firewall and SSO/integration points. If Option B, we’ll target Mon Oct 12 for the pre-call.

I attached an updated calendar (poc-calendar.ics) with both placeholders — please accept the one you pick so we can lock.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC Kickoff: Align on success criteria, timeline, and owners

Marissa / Alice —

I can take the Oct 10, 14:00 PT kickoff (Option A) — that works best on my side. I do want to request a 30-minute technical pre-call the day before so we can validate network egress, ports, and validate the sample dataset location. Proposed pre-call: Thu Oct 9, 11:00–11:30 PT.

Agenda for tech pre-call (suggested):
- Quick environment overview (Acme infra owner)
- Network / firewall / outbound IP list
- SSO / auth flow and test account setup
- Data handling & sample dataset location/size
- Any required allowlist or proxy configs

Dev — can you own the security checklist and confirm you can join the pre-call?

Thanks — I’ll tentatively accept the Oct 10 invite and will update after Dev confirms.

— Ethan
Ethan Park | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ethan.park@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>, Bob Liu <bob.liu@acme.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@acme.com>, Mei Zhang <mei.zhang@acme.com>

Date: Sat, 10 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: POC Kickoff confirmed — Oct 10 14:00 PT (tech pre-call Oct 9 11:00 PT)

Thanks everyone — locking in per the thread:

- Tech pre-call: Thu Oct 9, 11:00–11:30 PT — Attendees: Ethan Park (Redwood SE), Dev Patel (Redwood Security), Mei Zhang (Acme Security), Sam Park (Acme Infra)
- POC Kickoff: Fri Oct 10, 14:00–15:00 PT — Attendees: Marissa Cole (AE), Ethan Park (SE), Dev Patel (Security), Priyom Das (Customer Success), Alice Chen (Acme Product), Bob Liu (Acme Infra), Sam Park, Mei Zhang

Success criteria (from attached doc):
- End-to-end demo of the integration with a sample dataset (30k tokens)
- Completion of basic security checklist (outbound IPs, SSO test account)
- Smoke test showing <200ms token latency on targeted flow
- Ops runbook handed off to Acme (owner: Priyom Das)

Action owners:
- Redwood tech: Ethan (demo + onboarding scripts), Dev (security checklist)
- Redwood AE: Marissa (agenda, customer communication, and kickoff notes)
- Redwood CS: Priyom (post-kickoff adoption plan)
- Acme: Alice (product owner), Sam (infra), Mei (security), Procurement (PO/contract follow-up)

Procurement — if you can share any PO timing constraints that would be helpful; we’ll keep the kickoff independent of final contract sign-off but want to make sure procurement has the info they need.

Attachments: acme_poc_success_criteria_v1.docx (final), poc-calendar.ics (accepted invites).

Looking forward — I’ll send meeting notes + recording link post-kickoff.

Best,
Marissa
